name: ISRIC SoilGrids Soil Properties
description: Global SoilGrids 250 m soil-property coverage access with selectable property, depth interval, and prediction statistic through public WCS.

metadata.label: ISRIC SoilGrids Soil Properties
metadata.constraints: Model predictions at 250 m resolution are not parcel-scale measurements. SoilGrids WMS does not publish EPSG:3857, so AEGIS exposes bounded WCS coverage access instead of an invalid Web Mercator map overlay.
metadata.human_summary: Global modeled soil properties for environmental, agricultural, erosion, and site-context analysis.
search_examples: get soil pH coverage around Zurich
download clay coverage in this bounding box
get soil organic carbon coverage around the selected site
disambiguation_notes: Use SoilGrids for modeled regional soil context, not parcel-level laboratory measurements.
metadata.location_dependency: A bounding box is required to generate a bounded GeoTIFF coverage download URL.
integration_requirements: Use WCS for bounded coverage extraction
metadata.rate_limit_notes: Keep requests spatially bounded and cache repeated access.

knownLimitations: SoilGrids is a modeled 250 m product and is not a substitute for local soil sampling.
The public OGC service is external and best-effort.
AEGIS does not render SoilGrids directly as a Web Mercator map because the service does not advertise EPSG:3857.
